# Sugar Bombs - All locations including map

![Sugar Bombs - All locations including map](/uploads/663_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Sugar bombs are a pack of sweet cereals that claim to provide 100% of the daily recommended sugar requirement. Sugar bombs were preserved so that they could still be consumed 25 years after the Great War. However, most of the packs have now received some radiation. There is also a rarer clean version, although it cannot be used for cooking. Only sugar bombs with radiation can be used for cooking.

### You can use sugar bombs (with radiation) for the following recipes:

- Brain bombs (most used)
- Sunburnt
- Sweet cake
- Sweet tea according to grandma's recipe

## Locations with sugar bomb spawns

Keep in mind that the sugar bombs only spawn if they are not in your loot list. So if you want to farm sugar bombs, it's best to empty the list first and then change the world. See: Respawning items & enemies / loot lists

## Clean sugar bombs

Sugar bombs without radiation can be found less frequently and are not included in the list above. They can also be crafted using the machines at the Sunshine Meadows Industrial Farm workshop. Unfortunately, they cannot be used for cooking without radiation.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-sugarbombs-20241214142553-1.jpg)
